changelog:
Initial release of rdd: Requirements-Driven Development MVP.

- Introduces a stepwise workflow to refine raw requirements into verifiable specs before coding.
- Defines core work item types, statuses, and traceable relationships for complete requirement-to-code mapping.
- Enforces clear separation of roles and steps: Requirement Analysis, Spec Writing, Test Contract, Implementation, and Verification.
- Mandates explicit handling of open questions, assumptions, and human-in-the-loop decision records.
- Supports handling new features, incremental changes, module replacements, and lightweight changes in existing systems.
summary: Requirements-Driven Development — converge fuzzy requirements into specs before coding. Trigger: RDD, 需求收敛, 需求驱动开发, requirement driven, 先理清再动手.
